purpose: Video-derived pose/expression/geometry nearest-neighbor search; Many Faces is the application

input_lock.extraction: MediaPipe 0.10.32 native CPU/IMAGE and OpenCV 5.0.0; unchanged production JavaScript feature conversion

query_selection: Every valid detected face in the existing full video; no future-dependent profile-island exclusion
diagnostic_limit: One existing already-composited public sample, not independent raw videos or an identity-recognition benchmark
ground_truth: Global top 64 under the frozen production projectionError.strictTotal, ties by canonical candidate ID
warmup: Only database-derived queries; reset every temporal/window history before measurement
fail_closed: temporal result disagrees with exhaustive reference
interpretation: Empirical engine implementations, not a pure language-independent algorithm comparison; score recall is not human perceptual similarity accuracy
report_all: Keep every fixed parameter point, difficult frame, repetition, order and failed attempt; no favorable-seed or fastest-run selection
registration: Internal fixed protocol; not external preregistration or independent certification
